name: Clark Smith Davenport

birth.place: Smith's Clove (Monroe), Orange Co., NY (per FamilySearch tree)

death.place: Plymouth Twp., Luzerne Co., PA (FS); buried in Plymouth (Giles & Franklin)

residences.note: FS tree, 1870 census; Giles & Franklin say the family lived 11 years in Ohio

bioAdditions: Clark Smith Davenport was a son of Stephen Davenport (b. 1751) and Sarah Smith, and a grandson of Oliver Davenport of the Philipstown (Putnam Co., NY) Davenports, which made him a cousin of the Plymouth Davenports. He married Temperance Pringle of Plymouth, daughter of Samuel and Martha (Lamoreux) Pringle, on 16 Oct 1825; they lived 11 years in Ohio, and he died in 1875 and was buried in Plymouth (S1). Their nine children were James (1826), Ziba Samuel (1829-1895), Martha (1830), Sarah Lydia (1831-1918), Samuel Marshall (1834-1920, m. 1861 Harriet Gould), Charles (1836), Lydia (1837-1918), Clark (1840) and William (1843) (S1, S2). The FamilySearch tree has him in Plymouth for the 1830, 1850 and 1860 censuses and in Washington Twp., Wood Co., Ohio, in 1870, so the Ohio years were probably about 1865-75 (S2).
